response.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT o.ordertune AS ordertune, COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS cnt FROM orderexecutions e JOIN orders o ON o.recordvault = e.ordersmark GROUP BY o.ordertune), shares AS (SELECT ordertune, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM counts) AS share FROM counts), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS a FROM shares) SELECT SUM(s.cnt) AS total_count, AVG(s.share) AS avg_share, AVG(s.share - (SELECT a FROM avg_share)) AS avg_excess FROM shares s WHERE s.share > (SELECT a FROM avg_share)
